item.title: New parenting space opens in Cushwa-Leighton Library
item.description: When students arrive to Cushwa-Leighton Library at Saint Mary's College, many are burdened with homework or an upcoming exam. But others carry an additional burden: children.To accommodate this, the library has changed the layout of an old room, removing old printers and adding a changing table. It is one of many recent initiatives at Saint Mary's aimed at garnering support for pregnant and parenting students on campus.Liz Baumann, director for harassment, education and response at Saint Mary's

item.title: Notre Dame women's golf finishes T-11th in FAU tournament
item.description: The Notre Dame women's golf team flew to Florida Atlantic University this past weekend facing 17 teams, including Clemson, which is an ACC competitor. The team finished with a combined score of 891 (+27,) tying with the University of Cincinnati for 11th place.The tournament was hosted on the Osprey Point Golf Course in Boca Raton, Florida. item.title: Holy Cross announces Alex Jones, founder of Hallow, as 2026 commencement speaker
item.description: Holy Cross College announced Alex Jones, chief executive officer and founder of Hallow, a Catholic prayer and meditation app, will deliver their 2026 commencement ceremony address on May 16. item.title: A balanced attack is the key for Notre Dame women's basketball in a Virginia Tech comeback
item.description: Notre Dame returned from a California road trip to take on the red-hot Virginia Tech Hokies on a seven-game win streak. In Irish alum and Virginia head coach Megan Duffy's return to South Bend, the Irish put together one of their most complete performances, gaining a critical conference win to bring them to 15-8. item.title: Notre Dame men's basketball falls just short against Florida State at home
item.description: The Notre Dame men's basketball team entered its Saturday afternoon tilt against Florida State with dwindling hopes of an invite to the ACC tournament bracket. Those chances fell further after a 82-79 loss in Purcell Pavilion.Notre Dame came into the match with three consecutive losses to Virginia, Syracuse and Louisville.
